Quick Reference — Turmeric Market Survey, Ghana (R1)
Every survey
1. Greet. Introduce yourself and your organisation.
2. Ask what she sells.
3. No turmeric, declined, or closed → Contact Log. Stop here.
4. Read the consent script aloud in her language. Record her answer.
5. Type the market — same spelling every time.
6. Choose seller type. Describe the stall so it can be found again.
7. Tick every turmeric form on sale now.
8. Photograph: card flat beside the turmeric, same light, whole card in frame.
9. Enter the price she quoted and her exact measure. Never convert.
10. Record packaging, brand, stock. Origin only if she offers it.
11. Tap RECORD LOCATION at the stall.
12. Tap FINISH at the stall, with her.
Limits
* 15 surveys per day.
* 20 surveys total.
* GHS 7 per verified survey.
* Contact Log: never paid, never counted.
Paid only if all four are true
* Started between 07:00 and 19:00.
* Took five minutes or more.
* Consent recorded as given.
* Seller sells turmeric.


Nothing else changes your pay.
Never
* Take, buy or carry away turmeric.
* Tell a seller her turmeric is good, bad or safe.
* Survey the same seller twice.
* Photograph or ask before she says yes.
Stop or escalate
* Unsafe: leave, then call your coordinator the same day.
* "Is my turmeric safe?": the survey judges nobody's product. Pass it on.
* Poor GPS: step into the open, retake. Never blocks you, never costs pay.
* Blurred photo: retake now. It cannot be fixed later.
Need help?
